title: Popular ways to automate Microsoft Outlook
summary: If your company uses Microsoft Outlook to manage both your email and calendar applications, then you probably spend a decent chunk of time in the Microsoft ecosystem. That's a given. But what about the rest of your tech stack? Whatever apps you use, you'll want a reliable way to connect them to Outlook, so that you can automate business-critical tasks to free up your time and get more priority work done.
